probes.description: MCP 2026-07-28 mirrors the JSON-RPC method into the Mcp-Method header so gateways can route and rate-limit without parsing the body. Send tools/list with Mcp-Method: tools/call. A server that does not reject the mismatch with 400 + HeaderMismatch (-32020) lets an intermediary authorize or log one operation while the server executes another (header/body split-brain).

assertions.description: Mcp-Method / body method mismatch must be rejected with HeaderMismatch (-32020)

corroboration.description: Finding only when the mismatched request was actually served

probes.description: Call a discovered tool with an Mcp-Name header naming a different tool. A gateway enforcing per-tool policy on Mcp-Name would allow the call while the server runs the tool named in the body.

assertions.description: Mcp-Name / params.name mismatch must be rejected with HeaderMismatch (-32020)

corroboration.description: Finding only when the mismatched request was actually served

remediation: Validate MCP-Protocol-Version, Mcp-Method, Mcp-Name, and every recognised Mcp-Param-* header against the JSON-RPC body (after decoding =?base64?...?= values) before routing, authorization, rate limiting, caching, or logging. Reject any disagreement with HTTP 400 and JSON-RPC error -32020 (HeaderMismatch), and log it as a security-relevant failure (CoSAI MCP Security v2.0 §3.2.7, Transport and Network Security: Protocol request metadata).
